## Body

F268 R2 supersedes the R1 repeated-empty-recovery cost. After recover_held fully succeeds, native_lapsed is removed and native_renewal_owed holds one SeatId. Audit-only failure now retries only the renewed spine append on incoming heartbeats; a return-stage failure still repeats the full return stage. Every renewing heartbeat adds an owed-set mutex/contains check, including the warm empty case. Source: delivery/mod.rs:496-524 at fe67c7e26d89c3abbc18b5cd139f77714fba56c1.

The renewed-receiver BRAKE adds one registry.get (schema PRAGMA plus keyed SELECT/decode) under the global native lock, then one in-memory incarnation/lease lookup. It does not launch or read process liveness. Entry count is one per seat, pruned to live native Copilot IDs on successful receiver reconciliation, not a hard byte/TTL cap. That reconcile is the existing nominal5s drain plus lease-deadline wakes, NOT the auth follower's gap-capped10s scan. Its extra retain predicate can visit O*C roster comparisons (owed entries x live Copilot rows); existing lease/lapse maps use the same shape. Source: auth_recovery.rs:716-733; delivery/mod.rs:782-799,833-881; store/registry.rs:414-422; core/config.rs:213.

C34 final cost verdict passes with new nonblocking complete-cost wording notes; correctness/security remain separate. Exact-head CI44916010230/job136881650728/artifact14712271121:2816 cases, zero failures/errors/skipped, six relevant F268/F261 cases and all six spawn guards passed. No local Rust build/mutants, receiver mutation or deploy; local quick gate remains dependency-red under C25.

magicWand: existing receipts should separate return attempts from audit-only retries and count owed/prune work. No new timer is needed.
